title: Southern Fried Chicken Biscuits
description: A classic comfort food dish featuring crispy fried chicken, flaky biscuits, and a side of nostalgic charm. Perfect for a Southern-style brunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in lard with a pastry blender or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Pour in buttermilk and stir until dough comes together in a shaggy mass.
Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead gently until it comes together.
Roll dough out to about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thickness.
Cut into biscuits using a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place biscuits on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake biscuits in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
While biscuits are baking, prepare chicken by drying with paper towels and seasoning with salt, pepper, and hot sauce.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Dredge chicken in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip floured chicken in beaten eggs and then coat in flour mixture again.
Heat about 1/2 inch (1 cm) of lard in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to skillet and cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Serve fried chicken with warm biscuits and a side of nostalgia.
